questions.title: 不在旧客户名单的新增客户
questions.context: 运营想找出名单里新出现的客户，已在老名单里的不算。
questions.requirements:

输出列名称及顺序：customer_id。

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: SELECT DISTINCT n.customer_id FROM new_customers n WHERE n.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM old_customers o WHERE o.customer_id=n.customer_id)
